0x00000001c0b3230c  0x00000008  __TEXT,__text  objc  -[TransparencyIDSRegistrationRequest setInitialTimeout:]  // -[TransparencyIDSRegistrationRequest gb, weq); 
  float maxRGB = max(max(im.r, im.g), im.b); 
  luma = 0.5 * (luma + maxRGB); 
  luma = log2(1.0 + luma); 
  float light = dot(lm.rgb, weq); 
  light = log2(1.0 +light); 
  float glog2 = a.x * light + a.y * luma; 
  float g = exp2(glog2) - 1.0; 
  return vec4(g, g, g, 1.0);
